text:
ana: Heads up — I found a 404 in the runtime guide during a smoke test: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#prefetch -> returns 404
sam: ack. which page had the link? can you paste the offending href?
ana: it's in the 'Batching & KV' section, inline link to `/v2/advanced/prefetch` (was probably renamed). snippet:
```
See prefetching details: /v2/advanced/prefetch
```
jordan: thanks for flagging. pinging @mikayla for docs ownership — last touched this area in #1442
mikayla: assigning to self for triage. i'll open a tiny PR to re-route to `/runtime/prefetching` or the new anchor.
ana: ok great. can you also add a redirect shortlink? customers hit this via search.
mikayla: yep — plan: PR to change the href + add a netlify redirect. target ETA: today EOD. will post links.
docs-bot: Reminder: please add the 'docs-owner' label and link to related issue when opening PR :robot_face:
sam: also, if you need quick CR, @jordan and I can review — tag `rr` for fast approvals.
mikayla: thanks — will tag `rr` and drop the PR here when ready :raised_hands:
ana: appreciate it! small follow-up: any chance to add a one-liner note in the runtime changelog so support sees it?
mikayla: yes, adding a changelog line in the PR description.
sam: perfect. marking this resolved in the thread once PR merges. :thumbsup:
